items.title: Meta Ads: $148.01 spend, 6 leads, $24.67 CPL — Flooring Problems Campaign
items.summary: Last successful run was 2026-08-14 (covering 2026-08-13), so this run widened to a 3-day window (2026-08-14 to 2026-08-16, America/Toronto) to close the gap. Across those 3 days, Meta spent $148.01 entirely on the only actively-delivering campaign, Flooring Problems Campaign, generating 6 leads at $24.67 CPL. That's above the 7-day baseline CPL (~$17.66 over $353.15 / 20 leads) but under the 2x anomaly threshold; account is ACTIVE and no ads are flagged.

needs_attention: Window widened: last successful meta-ads run was 2026-08-14 (folder date), covering only 2026-08-13. This run used --days 3 (2026-08-14 to 2026-08-16) to cover the resulting 3-day gap through yesterday, per the ingest agent's window-gap rule.

Flooring Problems Campaign's raw actions again include lead-like conversion types outside the script's documented LEAD_ACTION_TYPES set (offsite_complete_registration_add_meta_leads, offsite_search_add_meta_leads, offsite_content_view_add_meta_leads — each valued at 6 over the 3-day window / 20 over the 7-day baseline, matching the counted leads exactly both times, same pattern noted on 2026-08-14). No discrepancy in the counted total, but per the agent's trap note this should be reviewed for whether the script's lead-action set needs extending, not hand-patched here.
